scene.title: Natural Selection Shifts Trait Frequencies
scene.summary: Selection favors advantageous traits, changing their frequencies in the population over generations.

entities.text: Initial population: Trait A 60%, Trait B 40%
After selection: Trait A 80%, Trait B 20%

beats.title: Variation in the population
beats.narration: The population contains two traits: A (60%) and B (40%).

beats.title: Selection pressure appears
beats.narration: A predator preferentially eats individuals with Trait B, reducing their survival chance.

check.question: What will happen to the proportion of Trait B after one generation?
check.explain: Trait B is selected against, so its frequency will drop.

beats.title: Shift in trait frequencies
beats.narration: After one generation, Trait B becomes less common while Trait A becomes more common.

beats.title: Result of natural selection
beats.narration: Natural selection has increased the frequency of the advantageous trait A and decreased trait B.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: Natural selection changes a population by favoring traits that improve survival, altering trait frequencies over generations.

warnings.message: this beat changes nothing on the board — add an action the learner can see
